headline: Humphries pulls out of the European Championship with illness
standfirst: World number two Luke Humphries withdrew from the European Championship in Dortmund with gastroenteritis, and Kim Huybrechts took his place.
body: Luke Humphries withdrew from the European Championship in Dortmund on the opening day because of gastroenteritis, BBC Sport reported. The world number two had been among the favourites after a strong autumn.

Humphries arrived in Germany in good form. He had won the World Grand Prix in Leicester at the start of October and then reached the final of the Swiss Darts Trophy in Basel, where he lost 8-4 to Jonny Clayton.

Kim Huybrechts replaced him as the highest-ranked player on the 2026 European Tour rankings who had not already qualified. The Belgian said he received the call at about 9.30am and drove three hours to the venue.
Huybrechts made the most of the late call-up. He beat Ryan Searle 6-1 in the first round, hitting six maximums and checking out at 67%, to set up a second-round meeting with Stephen Bunting.
The opening session also produced a nine-dart finish. Luke Woodhouse hit it in a 6-3 win over Dirk van Duijvenbode.
